name: NotificationCenter
summary: Inbox of system + user notifications. Popover-anchored from a Bell icon in the Navbar (default) or a route at /inbox. Items group by recency (Today / Earlier / Last week). Unread items carry a leading dot in text.accent. Hosts read/unread toggle, mark-all-read, archive, and category filter chips. Distinct from Toast (transient) and Alert (in-flow).

items.description: NotificationItem children or array. Each item: id, title, body, source, time, read, severity (info / warning / danger / accent), action.

unreadCount.description: Total unread. The trigger's Bell icon paints a count badge when > 0.

onArchive.description: Fires with the item id when archived.

trigger.description: Override the default Bell icon-button trigger. Use to mount the center on a Navbar slot of your choice.

keyboard: Enter - open focused item / activate action
M - mark focused item as read
rules: Trigger button has aria-label='Notifications, {N} unread' so SR users hear the count even when the badge isn't visible.
Each NotificationItem is a list item (<li>) with role='button' OR an <a> when it routes to an entity.
Unread items set aria-current='true' OR are announced via aria-live='polite' on the parent region when new items stream in.
Filter chips are roving-tabindex tabs (radio-group semantics).
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: skip the entry zoom-in; keep the fade.

do: Group items by recency (Today / Earlier / Last week).
Lead each item with the source ('Sterling LTL', 'AI Quote', 'Audit log').
Use the brand-accent dot for unread.
Pair with a 'Mark all as read' action and a per-item archive swipe / button.
Empty state: 'You're all caught up.' centered with an EmptyState illustration.
dont: Don't paint the unread dot in danger red unless the item is critical (failure, escalation).
Don't put marketing copy in the NotificationCenter.
Don't auto-route on item click without a clear confirmation that the action happened.
Don't render more than 50 items in the panel — paginate or route to a full /inbox page.

changelog.note: Initial NotificationCenter contract. Popover-anchored inbox with unread/mark-all-read/archive/filter primitives.
